score.field: - Each image is a single solid white triangle pointing upward, on a black background, roughly centred horizontally. - The apex is near the top centre, around row 1–3 and column 5–6. - The base is a horizontal edge somewhere between row 6 and row 10. It typically spans about 6–10 pixels, reaching columns 1–2 on the left and 9–10 on the right. - The triangle is about 5–9 pixels tall and 6–10 pixels wide at the base. Size and steepness vary between samples. - Row 0, columns 0 and 11, and usually row 11 stay black.
